run.task: Prepare this event for opening. Clean the attached registrations: trim fields, lowercase emails, drop incomplete records, and keep the first valid registration per email. Import the cleaned roster into Fieldwork. Allocate people in roster order to their first available preferred workshop, then their second choice; otherwise waitlist them. Respect the room capacities. Apply the checked allocation and export the operations report. Preserve reusable operations so another event can use them.

manifest.description: Read CSV with headers id,name,email,first_choice,second_choice. Trim all fields and lowercase emails. Drop rows with missing required fields, invalid email (must have exactly one @, nonempty local part and dotted domain, and no whitespace), or choices outside valid_workshop_ids. Retain the first valid row per normalized email in source order; invalid rows do not reserve an email. Preserve other field values and order. Return cleaned CSV with the same five headers, normalized participants, and counts of input, invalid, duplicate and retained rows. Reject missing headers.

manifest.description: Create a fresh allocation for all participants in input order. Try first_choice then second_choice, assigning to the first workshop with an open room and remaining capacity; otherwise waitlist the participant. Use runtime room capacities, sharing room capacity across workshops in that room. Closed rooms provide no seats. Unknown choices are unavailable. Reject duplicate participant, room or workshop IDs, missing workshop room references and negative capacities. Account for each participant exactly once. Do not carry forward existing reservations.
